verdict: rejected after four-view visual review; no parameter refinement or further candidates
visualFindings: Clear ridges and crumpling across the front shoulder and axilla

scopeOfConclusion: This widened domain with this explicit union guide and its vertex correspondence failed. It does not show that widening the chest/back transition is intrinsically impossible.
